title: Mean-Field Isotherm Calculation
action: Solve the implicit self-consistency equation Δμ/kT = ln(θ/(1-θ)) - g(θ)θ, where g(θ) = Σ_e ε_elec(θ) + (1/2) Σ_e θ dε_elec/dθ + Z ε_nn, with ε_elec(θ) = ε_elec^0 (1 - θ/θ_c)^2 for θ < θ_c and 0 otherwise, Σ_e = 8.977 for κ=0, Z = 4, T = 300 K. Numerically solve this equation over a range of Δμ/kT for the three parameter sets: (1) ε_elec^0=0.1 eV, ε_nn=0.02 eV, θ_c=0.4; (2) ε_elec^0=0.3 eV, ε_nn=0.02 eV, θ_c=0.4; (3) ε_elec^0=0.1 eV, ε_nn=0.02 eV, θ_c=0.2. For each parameter set, compute the equilibrium coverage θ at each Δμ point and save the results.
description: Mean-field adsorption isotherms for the three parameter sets, giving coverage as a function of electrochemical potential difference.
output_schema: CSV with columns: param_set (int: 1,2,3), coverage (float, dimensionless), delta_mu (float, units of kT), epsilon_elec0 (float, eV), epsilon_nn (float, eV), theta_c (float, dimensionless), T (float, K).

title: Grand-Canonical Monte Carlo Simulation
action: Perform grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations on a 30x30 square lattice with periodic boundary conditions using the coverage-dependent pair interaction model. For each of the three parameter sets, run the simulation over a range of delta_mu/kT values, using 200 equilibration and 200 averaging MC steps per site. Record the average coverage at each delta_mu and save the results.
description: Monte Carlo isotherms (coverage vs. electrochemical potential difference) for the same three parameter sets, obtained from exact grand-canonical simulations.
output_schema: CSV with columns: param_set (int: 1,2,3), coverage (float, dimensionless), delta_mu (float, units of kT), scan (string: 'forward' or 'backward' if hysteresis is present, otherwise 'single').
